texto: 1. **Uso y significado**: equals Spanish «without + infinitive». It indicates that the main action occurs without any other expected or due concomitant action: **Er verließ das Zimmer, ohne ein Wort zu sagen** (left the room without saying a word).

2. **Identidad de sujeto**: As with «um … zu», the construction of infinitive with **ohne … zu** is only used when the subject of both actions is identical. If the subjects are different, the **ohne dass** conjunction should be used with conjugated verb at the end: **Er ging, ohne dass ich es bemerkte** (left without me warning).
3. **Verbos separables**: The **zu** particle intersperses: **ohne anzuklopfen** (without knocking on the door); **ohne abzuwarten** (without waiting).

filas: Er ging, ohne dass wir es wussten.

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: contracts with suppliers and quality

frases.de: Der Lieferant hat die Preise erhöht, ohne uns rechtzeitig zu informieren!
frases.es: ¡El proveedor ha subido los precios sin informarnos a tiempo!
frases.en: The supplier has raised the prices without informing us in time!
analisis: Der Lieferant hat die Preise erhöht
the supplier has raised the prices

frases.de: Das ist inakzeptabel. Wir können den Vertrag nicht verlängern, ohne die Konditionen nachzuverhandeln.
frases.es: Eso es inaceptable. No podemos prorrogar el contrato sin renegociar las condiciones.
frases.en: That is unacceptable. We cannot extend the contract without renegotiating the terms.
analisis: Wir können den Vertrag nicht verlängern

frases.de: Genau. Und er hat die Ware geliefert, ohne die Qualitätsprüfung abzuwarten.
frases.es: Exacto. Y entregó la mercancía sin esperar el control de calidad.
frases.en: Exactly. And he delivered the goods without waiting for quality control.
analisis: Und er hat die Ware geliefert

frases.de: Wir fordern sofort eine schriftliche Stellungnahme an.
frases.es: Solicitamos de inmediato una declaración de postura por escrito.
frases.en: We immediately request a written statement of position.

bloques.pregunta: What is the meaning of «ohne … zu» construction?

opciones.texto: Expresses that the main action takes place without any other action expected or due to be carried out
opciones.explicacion: It indicates omission or deprivation of a possible concomitant action in the context.

opciones.texto: Expresses the ultimate goal or purpose of the subject with his action
opciones.explicacion: The positive purpose is formulated by «um … zu», not by «ohne … zu».

opciones.texto: Plantea una condición indispensable futura similar a «wenn»
opciones.explicacion: The hypothetical condition requires «wenn» or Konjunktiv, not a private modal clause.

bloques.pregunta: What structure should be used if the subjects of both sentences are different?

opciones.texto: «ohne dass» followed by a complete subordinate prayer with verb at the end
opciones.explicacion: The divergence of subjects prevents infinitive and requires the «ohne dass» conjunction.

opciones.texto: «ohne … zu» keeping the infinitive at the end of the sentence
opciones.explicacion: It is a serious grammatical error, as the infinitive would adopt an unidentified ghost subject.
«anstatt … zu» is also infinite and does not solve the discord of subjects.

bloques.frase: Er hat das Büro verlassen, ohne den Computer ___ .

opciones.explicacion: In the separable verb «ausschalten», «zu» is placed between the prefix and the root («aus-zu-schalten»).
The required mandatory «zu» particle is missing after «ohne».
It is a form of participle II, incompatible with the construction of infinitive.

bloques.frase: Sie ging gestern an mir vorbei, ___ mich zu grüßen.

opciones.explicacion: «ohne mich zu grüßen» states that he passed without saying hello.
It would mean «instead of saying hello to me», but the omission of a courtesy pattern is expressed with «ohne».
It would reverse the meaning («para saludarme»), contradicting the fact that it is passing by.

bloques.frase: Man darf das chemische Labor nicht betreten, ohne eine Schutzbrille zu tragen.

opciones.texto: It is mandatory to wear protective glasses when accessing the chemical laboratory.
opciones.explicacion: «ohne ... zu tragen» denies entry authorization if protection is not taken.

opciones.texto: It is advised not to wear protective glasses during chemical experiments.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the strict safety regulations of the laboratory.

opciones.texto: The protective glasses should only be used if the technician requests them in writing.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase prohibits entry in any case without wearing them.

bloques.frase: Er traf wichtige Entscheidungen, ohne über die Folgen ___ .

opciones.explicacion: In the separable verb «nachdenken», «zu» intersperses between the prefix and the infinitive («nach-zu-denken»).
The «zu» particle cannot be placed behind the base verb.
It is a form of past participle, not of terminal infinitive with «zu».

bloques.explicacion: subject + verb ging + ohne + zu grüßen at the end.

intro: The «ohne … zu» constructions express that an event takes place without a complementary action that could be expected in a natural way.
